admission.justification: The minimized line and dock tests guard nested event propagation so Close cannot also expand while retaining picks.

applicability: The minimized tray line drawn above a native composer or at its existing dock.
conditions: The target is outside a nested button, link, input, textarea or select, and outside a nested role=button, role=link or role=menuitem element. The guard does not inspect generic contenteditable elements.
exclusions: No new geometry or paste/capture semantics.

evidence: dashboard/src/tray/TrayDock.test.tsx::expands when the docked line itself is clicked, away from its button; dashboard/src/tray/TrayDock.test.tsx::keeps the close control on the docked line closing the tray, and does not expand on it; source-location and unchanged-byte audit: helpers/frontend/source-drift-current-W9.json; no fresh test execution.

statement: The minimized tray head expands on a click, Enter or space when the target is outside the nested controls listed by its guard; those controls retain their own action, so Close cannot also expand and continues to retain the picks.
